fixture_manifest.capture_mode: teacher-forced recorded continuation; no sampling or EOS override

metal.q8_arithmetic: MLX 0.31.1 fixed per-token QMV, FP32 input bias sums
metal.router_arithmetic: M1 SIMD 8x8, sixteen fixed K partitions
metal.expert_reduction: eight partial sums in selected-expert order
metal.attention_arithmetic: BF16 scores and probabilities, fixed across chunks

storage.scope: internal device counters, including other processes

after.gpu_timing_scope: expert pipeline command groups can include shared work

limitations: Resident fixture weights; no SSD waits, full-model state, or request-speed claim.
One group at a time; preallocated outputs, unchanged gate/up/down arithmetic; hashes checked outside timing.
The eight expert inputs are captured model inputs, not a replay of full-model routing.
